name: Glazeyard
summary: Glazeyard is a block-placement puzzle game for Android. The player places ceramic block pieces from a tray of three onto a grid to clear rows, columns and panes, irregular tile shapes drawn on each board. Each cleared pane fires from clay to glossy glaze and restores a sunlit courtyard. It has 300 hand-built levels in 10 chapters, an endless 8x8 Classic mode and a daily puzzle. Every tray can be placed and there is no timer. Single-player, playable offline, free with optional rewarded ads.
